title: Generating Frequently Asked Questions from Technical Support Tickets using Large Language Models
problem: Exponential growth in HPC user base and system complexity creates overwhelming volume and variability in technical support tickets; manual FAQ curation is unsustainable
motivation: Automate extraction of clear, accurate FAQs from raw support tickets to improve HPC support scalability and responsiveness
method: The system takes support tickets and filters them to focus on the most frequent and recent problems. It then uses an AI language model to summarize the tickets, groups similar problems together by understanding their meaning (semantic clustering), and generates FAQ entries from these groups. Finally, domain experts review the results.
key_novelty: The system uses AI language models to create FAQ entries automatically from support tickets by grouping similar problems, summarizing them, and generating questions and answers.
contributions: Scalable automated FAQ extraction from raw support tickets
Semantic clustering for issue categorization and subclustering
Multi-stage LLM generation producing understandable and factually sound FAQs
limitations: Evaluation limited to subject matter expert assessment; quantitative metrics for FAQ quality not specified; generalization to non-HPC domains unclear
